blocks.text: HONG KONG, China—Hundreds of people queued on Tuesday outside a Hong Kong gallery to see a Vincent van Gogh painting on public display for the first time in six decades. The Dutch artist’s “Chataigniers en fleurs” (“Chestnut Trees in Blossom”) was on show in Hong Kong ahead of its November 18 auction in New York. The auction is expected to smash records and fetch around $180 million, according to Sotheby’s.
